name: roboparts-mcp-server
description: MCP server for RoboParts — 868 robot component entities across 20 categories with 26 tools: compatibility (4-dim product layer + 3-axis research layer), mechanical interface, parameter-comparability, assembly preflight, VLA→body binding, research progress, plus dual-protocol negotiation (2024-11-05 / 2025-03-26 / 2025-11-25), long-task handles with cancel support, and redacted call traces for offline replay. Vendor-neutral: we neither manufacture nor resell any part. Full tool docs: https://roboparts.cc/docs/mcp-tools.md
author: RoboParts (https://roboparts.cc)
